caption:
Sixty instead of 120

The tempo said 120 and every bar fell apart. At 60 the boxes ticked one after another.

Slow is how a hard passage gets learned, and the speed arrives on its own.

For whoever slows the tempo down until it comes out clean.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table, a big clock at the right that says 120 bpm and a paper sheet titled scale under it. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes trembles at the left, then its eyes go wide, it steps closer and the clock drops to 60 bpm, and the four boxes on the sheet tick one after another. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me: faster will fix it, to: slower first. then faster.
